I am a graduate student in the Social Data Analytics program at the University of Texas at Dallas. Before that I worked in advertising, where I learned to argue with data, and I now create feminist media as an independent content creator (@鸡爪抓). My research asks how data—and the decisions behind it—shape who gets heard on digital platforms.

## Research Interests

- Gender inequality embedded in digital platforms and social systems
- Platform content moderation and algorithmic bias
- The data-generating processes behind platform metrics and official statistics
